snippet.title: Armored Core: For Answer - Xbox 360 / Ps3 Gameplay (2008)
snippet.description:
Armored Core: For Answer - Xbox 360 / Ps3 Gameplay (2008)

Subscribe: http://goo.gl/01dGfm


Armored Core: For Answer is a 3D vehicular combat mecha-based video game developed by FromSoftware and published by Ubisoft for the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360. It is the 13th installment of FromSoftware's Armored Core series. Armored Core: For Answer is the direct sequel to Armored Core 4, and takes place around ten years later. It was released in Japan on March 19, 2008, in North America on September 16, 2008, and in Europe on October 3, 2008.



Recorded by AverMediaGame Capture HD II
